data.narrative:
Retro Biosciences is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Joe Betts-LaCroix, evaluated within a broader Biotech & Health sector universe comprising 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable methodology: Stage-Progression. Using total capital raised of $180M as a proxy base valuation of $1.8B, application of a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to reflect progression from Series A to subsequent financing rounds implies a valuation of $3.6B. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (fewer than 3 datapoints after filtering). Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because Retro Biosciences does not disclose revenue, a prerequisite for applying the sector median P/S multiple of 5.5x observed across the three public biotech tickers.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $3.1B to $4.1B, with a median point of $3.6B. This range carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of revenue-based anchoring or narrow peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the standard 2.0x Series A step-up in early-stage biotech, where clinical or technical de-risking profiles vary substantially, and the undisclosed competitive standing relative to the identified private peer set.
